credentials.description: client_id of the environment (sandbox: developer account dashboard; production: Settings → API Keys, v4)

parameters.name: X-Trace-Id
parameters.description: A unique identifier to track this operation. It must be between 12 and 255 characters in length.

example_prompt: List the mobile money networks Flutterwave supports in a country, to fill mobile_money.network on a payout recipient.

name.description: The name of the mobile network operator.

message.description: Present on 401/403/409 bodies; the 400 body has none.

type.description: Error category. Generic: REQUEST_NOT_VALID, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND, RESOURCE_CONFLICT, UNPROCESSABLE, INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR; or a domain type (see code).

code.description: String. Generic 10400/10401/10403/10404/10409/10422/10500, or a domain code documented for this endpoint: none specific.

gotchas: Auth: one token server for both environments — the docs' Multi-Environment Integrations example sends either environment's credentials to https://idp.flutterwave.com/realms/flutterwave/protocol/openid-connect/token, and Authentication says "This process applies to both the sandbox and production environments. Make sure to use the correct credentials for each environment to obtain a valid token." "Each token is valid for **10 minutes**"; "We recommend refreshing the token at least one minute before it expires." Cache the token. Sandbox: "We archive your test data after 30 days."

Headers: X-Trace-Id is optional on this GET (the headers guide lists it under 'Optional API Headers'; "It must be a string using only alphanumeric ASCII characters.", 12-255 characters). The API reference documents no X-Idempotency-Key for this endpoint.

country is required (enum of 15 ISO alpha-2 codes). Docs (General Transfer Flow): "Use the Retrieve [mobile networks endpoint](/v4.0/reference/mobile_networks_get) to fetch available mobile money networks by country and pass the appropriate `network` value." Use data[].network, not data[].id.

Errors: {"status":"failed","error":{"type","code","message","validation_errors"}}; error.code is a string and 400s carry validation_errors[{field_name,message}]. Besides the generic codes (10400 REQUEST_NOT_VALID, 10401, 10403 FORBIDDEN, 10404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND, 10409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT, 10422 UNPROCESSABLE, 10500) the error table documents these for this endpoint: none specific. Branch on error.type / error.code, not on the HTTP status alone. Docs (Errors): "The current limit is 500 API requests per minute." A 429 can come back as a non-JSON page ("HTML error pages such as `Cloudflare 1015 responses`"): parse error bodies defensively and back off exponentially with jitter.
open_questions: Token URL: the PHP sample of Authentication uses https://keycloak.dev-flutterwave.com/realms/flutterwave/protocol/openid-connect/token; its curl and JavaScript samples and the Multi-Environment example use https://idp.flutterwave.com/realms/flutterwave/protocol/openid-connect/token, which this spec follows.

spans: Retrieve supported mobile networks by country.
